Warnings array is empty even for malformed HTML (parser is lenient)

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>Unclosed paragraph<div>Mixed nesting</p></div>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
        System.out.println(result.warnings());
    }
}
```
